The evidence can't show whether a rule was violated, because it contains no information on permits, legal status or protected-area boundaries. It only shows what changed on the ground.

- **Loss:** 0.6 ha of tree cover was lost in 2022 (3.41% of the 17.6 ha asset), after the 2020 baseline.
- **Corroboration:** The JRC 2020 map shows 100% of the event area was forest, and later years were observed, so the loss is corroborated.
- **Forest type:** The MGAP 2021 map classes about 0.5 ha as native forest and 0.1 ha as outside mapped forest. None of it is planted forest.
